envelope.description: Add the v2 task identity and a provenance-aware fingerprint

body.title: Add the v2 task identity and a provenance-aware fingerprint
body.summary: Give taskFinalInput and taskFinalIdentity an optional format: 'final-task-v1' (default) stays byte-identical; 'final-task-v2' hashes each test as { file, cases, result, blobOid }. Fingerprint test entries carry identity (v2 digest) and provenance (whole-row digest), and reuseMismatch takes the comparison format and compares provenance only under v1. Until t3, requireReuseIdentity passes 'final-task-v1' so behaviour is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: v1 identities equal the constants pinned from the pre-change code.
v2 identity ignores command, executionDetails and evidenceReferences and changes with test file blob, cases (including order) and result.
A task with no tests has a v2 identity over requirements, changes and documents.
Under v1 the rejection text names a provenance-only test change; under v2 it does not.
After t2 alone, existing reuse behaviour and rejection text are unchanged.
